codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.description: Runs a local Codex CLI session against one BookForge task bundle.
codex.command_template: codex exec --full-auto "Read the prompt file at {prompt}. Write only the finished Markdown artifact to {result}. Put brief execution notes in {notes}."

openclaw.label: OpenClaw CLI
openclaw.description: Placeholder command shape for an OpenClaw-style local agent CLI.

claude-code.label: Claude Code CLI
claude-code.description: Runs a Claude Code-style CLI with the prompt file and expected result path.
claude-code.command_template: claude -p "Read the prompt file at {prompt}. Complete the task and write the final Markdown to {result}."

paperclip-oauth.label: Paperclip OAuth Worker
paperclip-oauth.description: Placeholder command shape for a Paperclip-style authenticated worker bridge.
